raw: [name="Drunken Soldier"]Good job, Madam Speaker, I say!
speaker: Drunken Soldier
content: Good job, Madam Speaker, I say!

raw: [name="Drunken Soldier"]Rip up every tile in Londinium and root out the devil scum hiding under them! *cough* *cough*...
speaker: Drunken Soldier
content: Rip up every tile in Londinium and root out the devil scum hiding under them! *cough* *cough*...

raw: [name="Ragged Citizen"]I hear there's gonna be a big shipment of Oripathy meds coming in.
speaker: Ragged Citizen
content: I hear there's gonna be a big shipment of Oripathy meds coming in.

raw: [name="Ragged Citizen"]I got a friend at the procurement office. Maybe he can get me some meds first, and I'll see if I can get some for you, hah... cheers— *hic* —
speaker: Ragged Citizen
content: I got a friend at the procurement office. Maybe he can get me some meds first, and I'll see if I can get some for you, hah... cheers— *hic* —

raw: [name="Ragged Citizen"]You were strutting all day when you got into the duke's army... and then you went to the Exemplars, and now here you are after the end of the war, just like me.
speaker: Ragged Citizen
content: You were strutting all day when you got into the duke's army... and then you went to the Exemplars, and now here you are after the end of the war, just like me.

speaker: Ragged Citizen
content: Two Infected with nothing left—

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Drunken Soldier
content: Who are you calling Infected?!

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.7, xstrength=40, ystrength=40, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="Drunken Soldier"]I can fight! I'm not like you! I'm not afraid to die... *vomit*—
speaker: Drunken Soldier
content: I can fight! I'm not like you! I'm not afraid to die... *vomit*—

raw: The other patrons look up at the staggering soldier.
content: The other patrons look up at the staggering soldier.

raw: A coin flies across his face and lands on the bar counter. A haggard figure grabs him by the shoulder.
content: A coin flies across his face and lands on the bar counter. A haggard figure grabs him by the shoulder.

raw: [name="Shearer"]He's drunk. Take him home. I've got the bill.
speaker: Shearer
content: He's drunk. Take him home. I've got the bill.

speaker: Shearer
content: Don't mind what they said, madam.

speaker: Catherine
content: He's just telling the truth, Lieutenant.

speaker: Shearer
content: I'm retired too. But suit yourself.

raw: [name="Catherine"]Sure. As for your question... it doesn't matter if I was talking to the one whose name's on the warrant, or Reunion, or anybody else.
speaker: Catherine
content: Sure. As for your question... it doesn't matter if I was talking to the one whose name's on the warrant, or Reunion, or anybody else.

raw: [name="Catherine"]The workers want to do something for our home. I can't just stand by and watch everything get worse.
speaker: Catherine
content: The workers want to do something for our home. I can't just stand by and watch everything get worse.

raw: [name="Catherine"]Extraordinary times call for extraordinary measures. That's how things have always been for us.
speaker: Catherine
content: Extraordinary times call for extraordinary measures. That's how things have always been for us.

raw: [name="Shearer"]Just friendly advice. I've seen what medicine from dubious sources can do. I watched a soldier collapse into his drink a couple of days ago.
speaker: Shearer
content: Just friendly advice. I've seen what medicine from dubious sources can do. I watched a soldier collapse into his drink a couple of days ago.

raw: [name="Shearer"]I'd performed emergency surgery on him during the war.
speaker: Shearer
content: I'd performed emergency surgery on him during the war.

raw: [name="Shearer"]That time, he survived. But this time... it was the last checkup he ever got.
speaker: Shearer
content: That time, he survived. But this time... it was the last checkup he ever got.

speaker: Catherine
content: You're a kind soul.

raw: [name="Catherine"]The apothecary in my neighborhood says he can't remember how many came to him for poison during the war.
speaker: Catherine
content: The apothecary in my neighborhood says he can't remember how many came to him for poison during the war.

raw: [name="Shearer"]I don't remember everyone I've ever treated, of course.
speaker: Shearer
content: I don't remember everyone I've ever treated, of course.

raw: [name="Shearer"]I've seen much worse in my time as field medic, but at least I get to see those who walk out the field hospital again.
speaker: Shearer
content: I've seen much worse in my time as field medic, but at least I get to see those who walk out the field hospital again.

raw: [name="Shearer"]Spend enough time drinking here, and you begin to recognize the faces in the crowd that you've seen before, even if it was only once.
speaker: Shearer
content: Spend enough time drinking here, and you begin to recognize the faces in the crowd that you've seen before, even if it was only once.

raw: [name="Catherine"]I know some doctors, the Rhodes Islanders. Maybe you need their help.
speaker: Catherine
content: I know some doctors, the Rhodes Islanders. Maybe you need their help.

raw: [name="Shearer"]You forget that I'm a physician myself... what do you think of the Exemplars?
speaker: Shearer
content: You forget that I'm a physician myself... what do you think of the Exemplars?

raw: [name="Catherine"]It's asking a lot, getting an old burdenbeast to remember something that long ago.
speaker: Catherine
content: It's asking a lot, getting an old burdenbeast to remember something that long ago.

raw: [name="Catherine"]It's ancient history, even to me. All I remember is that decades ago, when kids would brag about this and that, they wouldn't be tossing around the names of dukes, it was the Exemplars.
speaker: Catherine
content: It's ancient history, even to me. All I remember is that decades ago, when kids would brag about this and that, they wouldn't be tossing around the names of dukes, it was the Exemplars.

raw: [name="Catherine"]There were lots of heroes. Lots of them lost.
speaker: Catherine
content: There were lots of heroes. Lots of them lost.

speaker: Shearer
content: No, what I mean is—

raw: [name="Catherine"]I know what you wanted to hear, but I don't have anything else for you. Sorry.
speaker: Catherine
content: I know what you wanted to hear, but I don't have anything else for you. Sorry.

raw: [name="Shearer"]Most people in the new 'Exemplars' aren't soldiers. You can't compare them to the old ones.
speaker: Shearer
content: Most people in the new 'Exemplars' aren't soldiers. You can't compare them to the old ones.

raw: [name="Catherine"]We didn't start celebrating here in the city when the dukes defeated the Sarkaz, that's the end of it.
speaker: Catherine
content: We didn't start celebrating here in the city when the dukes defeated the Sarkaz, that's the end of it.

raw: [name="Catherine"]The walls were on fire, and unarmed Londiniers trapped inside with the Sarkaz.
speaker: Catherine
content: The walls were on fire, and unarmed Londiniers trapped inside with the Sarkaz.

raw: [name="Catherine"]Nobody knew if the dukes would spend the next two months talking before they entered the city. Nobody knew what would become of us.
speaker: Catherine
content: Nobody knew if the dukes would spend the next two months talking before they entered the city. Nobody knew what would become of us.

raw: [name="Catherine"]It was the Exemplars who came. No one can take away what you did, not in Londinium, at least.
speaker: Catherine
content: It was the Exemplars who came. No one can take away what you did, not in Londinium, at least.

raw: Catherine pauses. She notices the officer's hand trembling in the dim light of the tavern.
content: Catherine pauses. She notices the officer's hand trembling in the dim light of the tavern.

raw: He reaches into his pouch, trying to find something, but finally sighs and takes a big swig from his mug.
content: He reaches into his pouch, trying to find something, but finally sighs and takes a big swig from his mug.

raw: [name="Shearer"]These days, the only contribution most of us make is to the business of the city's drinking establishments.
speaker: Shearer
content: These days, the only contribution most of us make is to the business of the city's drinking establishments.

raw: [name="Shearer"]Thankfully, the kindly owner here doesn't throw out loitering drunkards.
speaker: Shearer
content: Thankfully, the kindly owner here doesn't throw out loitering drunkards.

raw: [name="Shearer"]After all, most of those who fought tooth and nail to get back home no longer have homes at all.
speaker: Shearer
content: After all, most of those who fought tooth and nail to get back home no longer have homes at all.

speaker: Shearer
content: To hard-won victory.

raw: Shearer raises his mug, but Catherine does not do the same.
content: Shearer raises his mug, but Catherine does not do the same.

raw: [name="Catherine"]I'm afraid you found the wrong drinking partner. I have an appointment to keep, and I intend to be sober for it.
speaker: Catherine
content: I'm afraid you found the wrong drinking partner. I have an appointment to keep, and I intend to be sober for it.

raw: [name="Catherine"]You're drunk, medic. Leave the alcohol to your later days.
speaker: Catherine
content: You're drunk, medic. Leave the alcohol to your later days.

raw: [name="Catherine"]I've heard the rumors about the Exemplars. Why don't you talk to the Speaker directly?
speaker: Catherine
content: I've heard the rumors about the Exemplars. Why don't you talk to the Speaker directly?

raw: Catherine gets up, goes around the other patrons, nods at the owner behind the counter, and disappears behind a door in the corner obscured by boxes.
content: Catherine gets up, goes around the other patrons, nods at the owner behind the counter, and disappears behind a door in the corner obscured by boxes.

speaker: Shearer
content: ...What makes you think I haven't?

raw: He looks in the direction where Catherine went. It leads to a forgotten corner of the city.
content: He looks in the direction where Catherine went. It leads to a forgotten corner of the city.

raw: The Defense Force patrols went in many times, but never found anything.
content: The Defense Force patrols went in many times, but never found anything.

speaker: Shearer
content: None of my business.

raw: He waves the proprietor over for another drink.
content: He waves the proprietor over for another drink.

raw: [name="Vina"]Lieutenant Shearer sent two messages. I asked the Messenger and both came from this underground pub.
speaker: Vina
content: Lieutenant Shearer sent two messages. I asked the Messenger and both came from this underground pub.

raw: [name="Morgan"]But Delphine said she made arrangements for all the surviving soldiers of Duke Windermere's ship.
speaker: Morgan
content: But Delphine said she made arrangements for all the surviving soldiers of Duke Windermere's ship.

raw: [name="Morgan"]Are you sure we don't want to check out the street that Delphine talked about first?
speaker: Morgan
content: Are you sure we don't want to check out the street that Delphine talked about first?

speaker: Vina
content: No. Let's go in.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="I followed behind Vina and let her open the door, because I was still used to kicking them in.", x=300,y=240, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
text: I followed behind Vina and let her open the door, because I was still used to kicking them in.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nThe Glasgow Gang never, ever, caused trouble in Auchterigg Borough.",block = true)]
text: \nThe Glasgow Gang never, ever, caused trouble in Auchterigg Borough.

text: Vina said we were just getting a drink with some old Exemplar friends, but I knew there was a lot on her mind.

text: \nShe had made arrangements to stop some factories and ration the refined Originium reserves for the winter.

text: \nBut the word 'Exemplars' was always there at the bottom of her memo—our old friends.

raw: [name="Excited Soldier"]Deal. You're gonna answer my questions frankly and truthfully, right?
speaker: Excited Soldier
content: Deal. You're gonna answer my questions frankly and truthfully, right?

raw: [name="Morgan"]As long as you beat me at arm wrestling.
speaker: Morgan
content: As long as you beat me at arm wrestling.

speaker: Excited Soldier
content: Brr—

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.7, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Morgan
content: Piece of cake.

raw: [name="Excited Soldier"]Hmph, I figured my injury wouldn't be a problem...
speaker: Excited Soldier
content: Hmph, I figured my injury wouldn't be a problem...

raw: [name="Morgan"]I know what you want to ask.
speaker: Morgan
content: I know what you want to ask.

speaker: Morgan
content: 'Will she disband the Exemplars?'

raw: [name="Morgan"]Honestly, I don't know. The stuff she's thinking about has been getting more and more complicated, and I've given up trying to figure it out.
speaker: Morgan
content: Honestly, I don't know. The stuff she's thinking about has been getting more and more complicated, and I've given up trying to figure it out.

raw: [name="Excited Soldier"]My guess is no. She even came to see us in the clothes that she wore when we fought together. If that's not sending a message, I don't know what it is.
speaker: Excited Soldier
content: My guess is no. She even came to see us in the clothes that she wore when we fought together. If that's not sending a message, I don't know what it is.

raw: [name="Morgan"]Didn't she say she just didn't want to draw too much attention?
speaker: Morgan
content: Didn't she say she just didn't want to draw too much attention?

raw: [name="Excited Soldier"]That's what's in all the books! You wouldn't get it.
speaker: Excited Soldier
content: That's what's in all the books! You wouldn't get it.

raw: [Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, style = "slider", inverse = true, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[name="Shearer"]What you see here is no exception.
speaker: Shearer
content: What you see here is no exception.

raw: [name="Shearer"]Many Exemplars are suffering from their lingering war wounds.
speaker: Shearer
content: Many Exemplars are suffering from their lingering war wounds.

raw: [name="Shearer"]With medicine in short supply, alcohol represents one of the few sources of comfort available to them.
speaker: Shearer
content: With medicine in short supply, alcohol represents one of the few sources of comfort available to them.

raw: [name="Shearer"]While some are here for information, most are here all day and night because they simply have nowhere else to go.
speaker: Shearer
content: While some are here for information, most are here all day and night because they simply have nowhere else to go.

raw: [name="Vina"]Is this why you wrote to me? To stand up for them?
speaker: Vina
content: Is this why you wrote to me? To stand up for them?

raw: [name="Shearer"]No... I see you have not read my letter.
speaker: Shearer
content: No... I see you have not read my letter.

raw: [name="Vina"]I'm sorry, there's been so much going on—
speaker: Vina
content: I'm sorry, there's been so much going on—

raw: [name="Shearer"]You used to be more straight and forthcoming, Madam Speaker.
speaker: Shearer
content: You used to be more straight and forthcoming, Madam Speaker.

raw: [name="Shearer"]If you think the Exemplars are calling for you to pay more attention to veterans' welfare, I can tell you that you're wrong.
speaker: Shearer
content: If you think the Exemplars are calling for you to pay more attention to veterans' welfare, I can tell you that you're wrong.

speaker: Shearer
content: They're waiting for your next order.

raw: [name="Shearer"]Everyone I've talked to for the past two months believes that Siege has grown since becoming Speaker, that she's getting even better as a leader.
speaker: Shearer
content: Everyone I've talked to for the past two months believes that Siege has grown since becoming Speaker, that she's getting even better as a leader.

raw: [name="Shearer"]And the question they ask the most is—where do we go next?
speaker: Shearer
content: And the question they ask the most is—where do we go next?

raw: [name="Vina"]Are you telling me to continue to send them to bleed and die, instead of trying to make life better for them?
speaker: Vina
content: Are you telling me to continue to send them to bleed and die, instead of trying to make life better for them?

raw: [name="Shearer"]You never truly saw yourself as their leader. You saw them as equals, as comrades in arms. I respect you for that, but it's also where you have failed in your responsibilities.
speaker: Shearer
content: You never truly saw yourself as their leader. You saw them as equals, as comrades in arms. I respect you for that, but it's also where you have failed in your responsibilities.

raw: [name="Shearer"]Forgive my frankness, but for many of them, what's left of their lives will never know a greater happiness than the taste of victory they enjoyed as the Exemplars.
speaker: Shearer
content: Forgive my frankness, but for many of them, what's left of their lives will never know a greater happiness than the taste of victory they enjoyed as the Exemplars.

raw: He grabs his mug and tries to take a swig.
content: He grabs his mug and tries to take a swig.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=40, ystrength=40, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
But it slips from his hands and falls to the ground.
content: But it slips from his hands and falls to the ground.

raw: The others look towards Shearer, whose eyes are red as he takes deep breaths, trying to keep himself under control.
content: The others look towards Shearer, whose eyes are red as he takes deep breaths, trying to keep himself under control.

raw: He takes out a coin, puts it on the table, and raises his hand at the proprietor without looking at him. On his part, the proprietor simply goes about cleaning up the mess without batting an eyelid.
content: He takes out a coin, puts it on the table, and raises his hand at the proprietor without looking at him. On his part, the proprietor simply goes about cleaning up the mess without batting an eyelid.

speaker: Shearer
content: One more of the same, please.

speaker: Shearer
content: Where were we, Madam Speaker?

text: I never got along well with Lieutenant Shearer. For a long time, Vina's fist knocking him dizzy had cemented my impression of him.

text: \nA field medic. Stubborn, but largely calm and dependable.

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\nHis surgeon's hands brought many back from the brink of death.",block = true)]
text: \nHis surgeon's hands brought many back from the brink of death.

speaker: Morgan
content: You... why—

speaker: Shearer
content: Lingering effect of an injury.

raw: [name="Shearer"]It was one hell of a battle, wasn't it?
speaker: Shearer
content: It was one hell of a battle, wasn't it?

raw: [Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="It wasn't his hand that was injured. I remember it well.", x=300,y=240, alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]

raw: [animtext(id = "at1", name = "group_location_stamp", style="avg_both", pos = "-400,-200", block = false)]<p=1>At the City Walls</><p=2>September 25th, 1098, 3:03 A.M.</>
content: <p=1>At the City Walls</><p=2>September 25th, 1098, 3:03 A.M.</>

raw: [name="Vina"]Any news about the situation in the city?
speaker: Vina
content: Any news about the situation in the city?

speaker: Delphine
content: Unclear.

raw: [name="Delphine"]As of yesterday, the Military Commission still had a heavy presence in important areas.
speaker: Delphine
content: As of yesterday, the Military Commission still had a heavy presence in important areas.

raw: [name="Delphine"]With the Royal Court elites deployed around the walls in a standoff with the dukes, however, the resistance within the city stands a better chance.
speaker: Delphine
content: With the Royal Court elites deployed around the walls in a standoff with the dukes, however, the resistance within the city stands a better chance.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=20, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="Indra"]The siege's gone on ten days already! When are the dukes gonna charge?
speaker: Indra
content: The siege's gone on ten days already! When are the dukes gonna charge?

raw: [name="Delphine"]If the priority is to minimize casualties amongst the allied forces, then besieging the city is the best way, particularly with the Duke of Wellington's position still uncertain...
speaker: Delphine
content: If the priority is to minimize casualties amongst the allied forces, then besieging the city is the best way, particularly with the Duke of Wellington's position still uncertain...

raw: [name="Morgan"]But they're playing with the lives of innocent citizens! If this drags on much longer...
speaker: Morgan
content: But they're playing with the lives of innocent citizens! If this drags on much longer...

raw: [name="Dagda"]Are they really okay with taking over an empty city?
speaker: Dagda
content: Are they really okay with taking over an empty city?

raw: [name="Dagda"]If the truth about the situation here gets out—
speaker: Dagda
content: If the truth about the situation here gets out—

raw: [name="Delphine"]Nothing gets out. They will not allow anything to happen out of their control.
speaker: Delphine
content: Nothing gets out. They will not allow anything to happen out of their control.

raw: [name="Delphine"]People often underestimate the dukes, but the truth is, they have never changed.
speaker: Delphine
content: People often underestimate the dukes, but the truth is, they have never changed.

raw: [name="Vina"]Just like how they treated the Steam Knights.
speaker: Vina
content: Just like how they treated the Steam Knights.

raw: [name="Delphine"]It's only one example... I can't say I know all of them well, but I knew my own mother.
speaker: Delphine
content: It's only one example... I can't say I know all of them well, but I knew my own mother.

raw: [name="Delphine"]Ethics is the first thing to go out the window when dealing with matters of shared interest.
speaker: Delphine
content: Ethics is the first thing to go out the window when dealing with matters of shared interest.

raw: [name="Delphine"]The focus had already shifted to how to retrieve The Shard tech at the joint staff meeting last night.
speaker: Delphine
content: The focus had already shifted to how to retrieve The Shard tech at the joint staff meeting last night.

speaker: Dagda
content: So they've already accepted this outcome.

speaker: Delphine
content: Dagda...

raw: [name="Dagda"]I need a squad, Siege. I'm going to try that Confessarius passage that Shining shared with us again—
speaker: Dagda
content: I need a squad, Siege. I'm going to try that Confessarius passage that Shining shared with us again—

speaker: Dagda
content: I'll be back, Vina. I promise.

speaker: Vina
content: Go.

raw: [name="Indra"]You're just gonna let her go like that?
speaker: Indra
content: You're just gonna let her go like that?

raw: [name="Indra"]I'm keeping an eye on you, Dagda. Now's not the time to play the hero!
speaker: Indra
content: I'm keeping an eye on you, Dagda. Now's not the time to play the hero!

raw: [name="Dagda"]Well, you'd better not fall behind then, Hannah.
speaker: Dagda
content: Well, you'd better not fall behind then, Hannah.

raw: [name="Vina"]Delphine, any updates from Feist and Rockrock?
speaker: Vina
content: Delphine, any updates from Feist and Rockrock?

raw: [name="Delphine"]They've reached the backup access port from when the wall was first built, but they can't find an opportunity to get close with all the Sarkaz patrols.
speaker: Delphine
content: They've reached the backup access port from when the wall was first built, but they can't find an opportunity to get close with all the Sarkaz patrols.

raw: [name="Delphine"]The Doctor's team is trying to give us an opening. One feint attack is all that it takes to create an opening, but...
speaker: Delphine
content: The Doctor's team is trying to give us an opening. One feint attack is all that it takes to create an opening, but...

raw: [name="Vina"]The alliance doesn't plan to attack at all.
speaker: Vina
content: The alliance doesn't plan to attack at all.

speaker: Delphine
content: Correct.

raw: [name="Vina"]Delphine, can you guarantee that you'll find a way inside, if there's a gap in the Sarkaz lines?
speaker: Vina
content: Delphine, can you guarantee that you'll find a way inside, if there's a gap in the Sarkaz lines?

raw: [name="Delphine"]Yes, but I need help. We can try to persuade the dukes again—
speaker: Delphine
content: Yes, but I need help. We can try to persuade the dukes again—
Vina shakes her head.

speaker: Vina
content: Give me two hours.

raw: [name="Vina"]I'll pull a squad with decent Arts skills and some battle drones. We'll feign an attack on the access port at N12 to draw their attention—
speaker: Vina
content: I'll pull a squad with decent Arts skills and some battle drones. We'll feign an attack on the access port at N12 to draw their attention—

speaker: Vina
content: You take the rest of them.

raw: [name="Delphine"]No! You'll be going to your death!
speaker: Delphine
content: No! You'll be going to your death!

raw: [name="Morgan"]Chetleigh, Brentwood, the Gloriana, Silverrock Bluffs... we were going to our deaths, each and every time.
speaker: Morgan
content: Chetleigh, Brentwood, the Gloriana, Silverrock Bluffs... we were going to our deaths, each and every time.

raw: [name="Morgan"]But somebody has to do it. I'm with you, Vina.
speaker: Morgan
content: But somebody has to do it. I'm with you, Vina.

raw: There is no answer from Vina. Morgan notices a strange look on her face.
content: There is no answer from Vina. Morgan notices a strange look on her face.

speaker: Morgan
content: ...Vina?

speaker: Vina
content: Urgent message from the Doctor—

raw: [name="Vina"]Loughshinny just went into the Wellington encampment.
speaker: Vina
content: Loughshinny just went into the Wellington encampment.

speaker: Morgan
content: ...Who's Loughshinny?

raw: [name="Shearer"]Tell the people behind us, no delay through the trenches!
speaker: Shearer
content: Tell the people behind us, no delay through the trenches!

raw: [name="Shearer"]The bulk of the Sarkaz forces are being tied up at the front, but that doesn't mean we have all day.
speaker: Shearer
content: The bulk of the Sarkaz forces are being tied up at the front, but that doesn't mean we have all day.

raw: [name="Exemplar Nurse"]Sir, there's a lot of equipment in the camp that we need time to—
speaker: Exemplar Nurse
content: Sir, there's a lot of equipment in the camp that we need time to—

speaker: Shearer
content: There is no time!

raw: [name="Shearer"]We can deal with the equipment issue once we get into the city.
speaker: Shearer
content: We can deal with the equipment issue once we get into the city.

raw: [name="Exemplar Nurse"]Some of the wounded can't walk on their own. We'll need to carry them by stretcher.
speaker: Exemplar Nurse
content: Some of the wounded can't walk on their own. We'll need to carry them by stretcher.

raw: [name="Shearer"]You follow the path that Siege has cleared for us. I'll organize the transfer of the wounded. Now go!
speaker: Shearer
content: You follow the path that Siege has cleared for us. I'll organize the transfer of the wounded. Now go!

raw: [name="Exemplar Nurse"]I'll help, sir. I'm more familiar with the situation of individual patients.
speaker: Exemplar Nurse
content: I'll help, sir. I'm more familiar with the situation of individual patients.

raw: [name="Exemplar Nurse"]Plus, I promised them I wouldn't leave them behind.
speaker: Exemplar Nurse
content: Plus, I promised them I wouldn't leave them behind.

raw: [name="Shearer"]Grab your own share of suppressant and protective gear from the patients' supplies. Better than nothing, at least.
speaker: Shearer
content: Grab your own share of suppressant and protective gear from the patients' supplies. Better than nothing, at least.

raw: [name="Shearer"]The closer we get to the walls, the higher the atmospheric Originium particle density. The wounded will be in more danger than us.
speaker: Shearer
content: The closer we get to the walls, the higher the atmospheric Originium particle density. The wounded will be in more danger than us.

speaker: Exemplar Nurse
content: Yes, sir.

raw: [name="Exemplar Nurse"]They say you're not a Londinier, sir. Why would you risk your neck like this?
speaker: Exemplar Nurse
content: They say you're not a Londinier, sir. Why would you risk your neck like this?

raw: [name="Exemplar Nurse"]Look! Another battleship is giving covering fire for the Gastrell!
speaker: Exemplar Nurse
content: Look! Another battleship is giving covering fire for the Gastrell!

speaker: Shearer
content: The Duke of Caster...

raw: [name="Exemplar Nurse"]Weren't they saying that the Duke of Wellington betrayed us and fell out with the Duke of Caster?
speaker: Exemplar Nurse
content: Weren't they saying that the Duke of Wellington betrayed us and fell out with the Duke of Caster?

speaker: Shearer
content: Shit!

content: What happened to the clouds?

content: The sky lights up with the fire on the city walls.

raw: The first wave of purple flame came from the bow of the Gastrell, gushing towards the walls of Londinium. And again. And again.
content: The first wave of purple flame came from the bow of the Gastrell, gushing towards the walls of Londinium. And again. And again.

raw: Like the cold waves of death that splashed against the sheer cliffs of Iberia.
content: Like the cold waves of death that splashed against the sheer cliffs of Iberia.

raw: It fell upon the Nachzehrers before Shearer, burning away the rot.
content: It fell upon the Nachzehrers before Shearer, burning away the rot.

raw: Londinium's walls are alight, ignited by Draco fire.
content: Londinium's walls are alight, ignited by Draco fire.

raw: The Sarkaz defenders became kindling for the purple inferno.
content: The Sarkaz defenders became kindling for the purple inferno.

speaker: Exemplar Nurse
content: Th—They're dead?

raw: [name="Shearer"]Careful. The fire has cleared a path, but it's a threat to us too.
speaker: Shearer
content: Careful. The fire has cleared a path, but it's a threat to us too.

speaker: Shearer
content: Hah.

raw: In the distance, he sees the figure on the withered throne fade in and out of the purple flames, gunfire from the ships roaring beside it.
content: In the distance, he sees the figure on the withered throne fade in and out of the purple flames, gunfire from the ships roaring beside it.

raw: On the walls, death ignites death.
content: On the walls, death ignites death.

raw: Beneath the walls, the living walk amongst the ashes of the dead.
content: Beneath the walls, the living walk amongst the ashes of the dead.

raw: [name="Shearer"]This is a war that will shock all the Core nations.
speaker: Shearer
content: This is a war that will shock all the Core nations.

raw: [name="Shearer"]It is not the number of casualties that will interest them the most... but how many people on both sides are actually fighting for the city of Londinium itself.
speaker: Shearer
content: It is not the number of casualties that will interest them the most... but how many people on both sides are actually fighting for the city of Londinium itself.

speaker: Shearer
content: It's a long way home for you.
